# Megastructures — synthetic fixture

megastructure_dyson_sphere = {
	name = megastructure_dyson_sphere
	prerequisites = tech_cruisers
	required_perks = { ap_one_vision }
	build_outside_gravity_well = no

	# Stage 0: Construction site
	0 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_0
		construction_days = 1800
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = { alloys = 2000 }
		}
	}

	# Stage 1: First ring
	1 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_1
		construction_days = 3600
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = { alloys = 10000 }
		}
		planet_modifier = { planet_jobs_energy_produces_mult = 0.50 }
	}

	# Stage 2: Complete sphere
	2 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_2
		construction_days = 3600
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = { alloys = 20000 }
		}
		planet_modifier = { planet_jobs_energy_produces_mult = 1.00 }
	}
}
